coverage.name: Alamosa County
limitations: Checked 2026-09-26: the Alamosa County Elections Department page lists only a Logic and Accuracy test notice (2026-09-24), past results and polling locations. No sample ballot, TABOR notice, ballot-content certification, or list/IGA of participating political subdivisions for the Nov 3, 2026 election is posted. County site search and DocumentCenter are JavaScript-driven and could not be enumerated; the site intermittently reset connections through the proxy.

Supporting (not a coverage basis): BOCC agendas and minutes Jun 3 - Sep 23, 2026 (AgendaCenter, saved as src-08003-bocc/) show no county-referred housing, land-use, lodging or tax question. The only county ballot topic discussed is a San Luis Valley-wide question to eliminate term limits for the 12th Judicial District Attorney (SLVCCA special meeting 2026-06-29; BOCC work sessions 2026-07-01 and 2026-07-27); it is not housing-related and its final certified text was not found. Re-check when the county posts its sample ballot / TABOR notice.

coverage.name: Alamosa (city)
limitations: Participation established from the City's own documents (Ordinance No. 19-2026 approving an IGA with Alamosa County for the Nov 3, 2026 coordinated election, second reading 2026-08-19; Resolution No. 13-2026 section 1 "An election shall be held as a coordinated election with the regular election on Tuesday, November 3, 2026"), not from a county participating-entities list, which the county had not posted as of 2026-09-26.

Reviewed source is City Council Resolution No. 13-2026 (ballot title and text, adopted for certification to the County Clerk by 2026-09-04), not a county sample ballot or TABOR notice; neither was posted by Alamosa County as of 2026-09-26. The Ordinance 19-2026 council communication states: "The City has no other issues at this election and would otherwise not be participating in it."

Excluded: City of Alamosa ballot issue (number not yet assigned, "__") - extension of the Streets Trust Fund one-half percent sales and use tax, 2030-2039, "TO BE USED SOLELY TO FUND STREET MAINTENANCE AND IMPROVEMENTS"; not housing.
Owner review: coverage state rests on the City referring resolution rather than the county-printed ballot; re-check against the county sample ballot / TABOR notice once posted.
